title: OpenDraft Configuration
description: Schema for opendraft.yml — the root configuration file in an OpenDraft repository.

protocol.description: Protocol revision block. Identifies which version of the OpenDraft protocol this repository uses.

version.description: Full 40-character Git commit SHA of the protocol revision.

commit.description: Full 40-character Git commit SHA (must equal version).

repository.description: Registered original project repository URL. Publishing is only allowed from this repository (fork rule).

manuscripts.description: List of manuscripts in this repository.

path.description: Relative path to the manuscript directory.

concept-doi.description: Concept DOI minted for this manuscript's Work at first publish. Written once, immutable afterwards.

concept-doi-repository.description: Repository URL at which the concept DOI was minted. Written once at first publish, immutable afterwards.
